chunk.content: In Taiwanese fish surimi products, milkfish was one of the main fish species identified, alongside dolphinfish, pomfret, swordfish and cartilaginous fishes.
chunk.source_quote: The main fish species identified included milkfish (Chanos chanos), dolphinfish (Coryphaena hippurus), Pomfret (Taractes rubescens), swordfish (Istiophorus spp.) and cartilaginous.

source.title: DNA metabarcoding unveils the hidden species composition in fish surimi: Implications for the management of unlabeled and mixed seafood products (doi:10.1016/j.heliyon.2024.e36287)
